source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the water cycle (PDF 230-232).

blocks.text: Paani ka (hydrological) chakkar paani ki abiotic hisson (hawa, mitti aur samandar) aur biotic hisson ke darmiyan musalsal harkat hai.

items: Evaporation: suraj chakkar chalata hai, satah ke paani ko garam kar ke bhaap banata hai. Duniya bhar ki bhaap ka taqreeban 86% samandaron se; Pakistan ke liye Arabian Sea andar ki taraf jane wali bhaap ka asal zariya hai.
Condensation: oopar uthti bhaap garmi kho deti hai; hawa kaafi thandi ho to qatron ya barf ke zarron mein badal kar gard ke zarron se chipak kar badal banati hai.
Precipitation: jab qatre bohat bhaari ho jayen to barish, barf ya sleet (barf ya olon mili barish) ban kar girte hain.

Infiltration aur runoff: zameen par paani ya mitti mein (percolation) water table tak ja kar zameeni paani ki shakal mein jama hota, ya mitti mazeed na le sake to satah par beh kar naalon, daryaon aur samandar mein jata hai.

blocks.alt: Suraj Arabian Sea ko garam karta; teer evaporation ko badalon (condensation) tak jata dikhata hai. Zameen par barish (precipitation). Paani zameen se daryaon aur samandar mein behta (surface runoff) ya zameen mein jazb ho kar (infiltration) zameeni paani tak jata. Darakht transpiration se paani chhorta, aur note batata hai ke janwar paani kaise lete aur lotate hain.
blocks.caption: Paani ka chakkar (Figure 25.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Abiotic chakkar mein suraj satah ke paani ko garam karta jo bhaap banta hai (duniya bhar ki bhaap ka taqreeban 86% samandaron se; Pakistan ke liye Arabian Sea asal zariya). Oopar uthti bhaap thandi ho kar gard ke zarron par jam kar badal banti, aur qatre bhaari ho kar barish, barf ya sleet ki shakal mein girte hain. Zameen par paani ya mitti mein jazb ho kar zameeni paani bharta ya satah par beh kar naalon, daryaon aur samandar tak jata hai. Biotic chakkar mein paude jarhon ke baalon se paani lete aur janwar peete aur khate hain; paani patton ke transpiration, respiration, excretion aur egestion, paseene aur gal sar kar wapas jata hai.

items: Dakhila: paude jarh ke baalon se mitti ka paani le kar photosynthesis aur sahara (turgor) mein use karte; janwar peete aur khane se paani lete hain.

Kharij: patton ke stomata se transpiration paudon se paani nikalne ka bara raasta hai; respiration metabolic paani banati jo saans mein nikalta; janwar peshab, faeces aur paseene mein paani khote; aur murda jismon ke galne se paani mitti aur hawa mein lotata hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baatein: Indus aur paani ka chakkar
blocks.text: Pakistan mein, jis ki zaraat aur maeeshat Indus darya ke nizam par chalti hai, paani ka chakkar qaum ki lifeline hai: satah ka behta paani Indus ko bharta, jab ke jazb hone wala paani peene ke paani ke zameeni zakhire bharta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa amal paudon se sab se zyada paani hawa mein lotata hai?

items: Abiotic chakkar: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, infiltration aur runoff.
Biotic chakkar: jarhon aur peene se lena; transpiration, respiration, excretion, paseene aur galne se lotana.
